name: Equal Opportunity Hater
teaser: Everybody hates each other just like on live. 3rd party all you want, i won't judge you.
description_html:
Install into your bepinx/plugins folder. If you did this correctly, you will see a dvize.EOH.dll file in your SPT/bepinex/plugins folder.

Two Bepinex Config Options (F12).

All pmcs hate eachother (yes even same side)

All scavs hate eachother (assault, cursedAssault)

how it works:
basically clear all the allies for a botowner and then add every bot thats alive to the enemies list when it spawns. is it perfect? no, but its better than running this constantly to add every new bot that spawned to the already spawned bots enemy list.

Its not perfect but it works for the most part
